Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry
The Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry invites you to join us in pursuit of your
dreams. There are so many great reasons to choose UAF and pursue a degree in chemistry
or biochemistry. There’s no place in the world quite like Fairbanks, Alaska and no
comparison to the education, research opportunities, community, and good times that
you will undoubtedly experience here.
ACS Approved
The American Chemistry Society (ACS) approval carries national recognition that the department meets high standards in its faculty,
facilities and curriculum. It is also a great resources for planning your future,
finding jobs and internships, and networking with other chemistry professionals.
Cutting-Edge Research
Contribute to cutting edge research opportunities and become part of the change. Faculty
members have more than two million dollars per year of grants and contracts from federal,
state, and private organizations including but not limited to NASA, Department of
Defense, NSF, and NOAA. We love undergraduate research too! Our undergrads have a
unique opportunity to use instrumentation, work with mentors and/or faculty, and even
get grant funding early in their degree.
Fulfilling Career Opportunities
A degree in chemistry or biochemistry can provide you with bountiful opportunities
in environmental science, medicine, academia, and so much more. Catapult yourself
into a fulfilling future with the Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry.
Degrees & Programs
Create a limitless future for yourself through our immersive, exciting, and challenging
programs.
Undergraduates
We offer an exceptional chemistry program with the option to concentrate in biochemistry
or environmental chemistry. Each program offers exciting opportunities to participate
in research, understand complex systems, and help shape your future.

Graduates
Now is the time to pursue your master's or PhD in chemistry or biochemistry!
We offer five exciting programs and excellent research opportunities in high-latitude
biological, physical, environmental, and human sciences.

APPLY TODAY
Accelerated B.S./M.S. Degree Program
We offer an action-packed Accelerated B.S./M.S. Chemistry degree program to help propel
you into an amazing career as soon as possible!
Whether you want to continue your education and go for your doctorate or jump right
into the work force, our accelerated program is designed to help you achieve your
goals quickly while still obtaining a quality education.
Don’t underestimate yourself.
Check it out
Funding Opportunities
Resources for funding
You don't have to go into major debt to pay for your education. There are tons of scholarships, grants, assistantships, and other funding opportunities at your finger
tips. So, go for it. Sky's the limit!
​
How to Apply
Login into the Scholarship Application System via your UAOnline account
Complete the General Application and any supplemental applications presented. You’ll
be automatically matched with scholarship opportunities for which you meet the criteria.
The system also provides additional recommended scholarships that may be available
to you.
If you are awarded a scholarship you will receive an award email to your UA email
address. You can also check on the status of your application by logging back into
the system at any time.
